query:
INSERT INTO invite (code_hash, inviter_id, created_at, expires_at)
               SELECT ?1, a.id, ?2, ?3 FROM accounts a
               WHERE a.id = ?4
                 AND (?5 IS NULL
                      OR (SELECT count(*) FROM invite
                          WHERE inviter_id = a.id AND created_at >= ?6) < ?5)
               RETURNING id AS "id!"
